_comment: LazyHub child MCP registry. Edit this file to add/remove/modify children, then call hub_rediscover (no editor reload needed for the hub to re-read it). 'cwd' is relative to the lazy-hub-mcp folder. 'env' lists which process.env keys are forwarded to that child (most children load their own credentials from a local .env or JSON file, so env is usually []). Optional 'callTimeout' (ms) overrides the default per-call timeout. THIS IS A TEMPLATE: it lists only the MCPs shipped in slt-toolbox-public. Add your own children with cwd paths pointing at wherever you checked them out, and remove any you do not use.
